description: Text of a unit as it was in force on a date, from the stored version history. supported is true when a history exists (reason is empty when a version is in force, or says no version is in force at that date, with a NULL text); supported is false when only the current version is stored (then only vigente_date is meaningful). No row means the urn is unknown. Parameters: urn (unit, article or act urn), date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: {"urn": "urn:nir:stato:legge:2000-07-27;212~art5-com1", "date": "2003-01-01"}.
